factors.comparison: fresh request over one with 16k tokens already cached

factors.comparison: past the limit over just below it (Llama-3.3-70B, one B200)
factors.tell: a cliff, not a slope: admission limits and memory headroom reduce the risk, but the safe point depends on the workload and the scheduler

factors.comparison: longest context without a collapse (4k for Llama-3.3-70B, 31k to 32k for the others) over 1k, design batch 64; long context forced a smaller batch on some servers
factors.tell: rises with context and more steeply at deep batch, where the stored context fills memory

factors.comparison: longest context (16k to 32k) over 1k, design batch 8
B200 over H100 on the same number of GPUs, at the same batch
factors.tell: no consistent saving: lower for some models, higher for DeepSeek-V2-Lite

factors.comparison: one B200 over the two H100s Llama-3.3-70B needs, at the same batch; changes GPU generation and GPU count together, and at the highest load also the cache reuse
factors.tell: a saving because the larger memory holds the model on fewer GPUs

factors.comparison: 8-bit over 4-bit weights, B200 (one pod per model)
factors.tell: a modest saving in the tested 4-bit deployments; one pod, so indicative
